title: What’s New: Reporting Features (For Developers and Consultants) (2024 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Export Report Schema and Get Custom XML
Mapping Report Fields to Word Documents

features.name: Export Report Schema for Word
features.description: New action to export report schema as XML file that can be injected into Word documents to enable mapping of report fields to layout elements.

features.name: Create Blank Report Layouts
features.description: New action to create a new empty layout for a report in Word, Excel, or RDLC format from the report object, allowing developers to start from scratch.

features.name: Update and Export Layout
features.description: New action that updates an existing layout with the latest report metadata, useful when a report extension adds more fields to the dataset.

features.name: Named Formulas for Excel
features.description: Simplifies Excel report formulas by providing named formulas that reference aggregated metadata instead of writing complex XLOOKUP or VLOOKUP formulas.

features.name: Report Layout Lifecycle Telemetry
features.description: New telemetry capability tracking changes to report layouts including when users change default layout, modify properties, export, replace or delete layouts.

features.name: Set Report Filename Event
features.description: New event called OnSetFileName that allows subscribers to set the file name for reports that are downloaded.

features.name: VS Code Data Item Snippet
features.description: New VS Code snippet for data link item called 'or data item' to help developers quickly scaffold data item declarations.

features.name: Report Layout Property Deprecation
features.description: Properties Report.WordLayout, Report.RdlcLayout and Report.ExcelLayout are being deprecated as they no longer make sense when reports can have multiple layouts.
caveats: Developers should move layout to the rendering section in the report object
